title: Antaeus
summary: Raleigh names Antaeus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Antaeus the gyant, whom Hercules slew in Lybia; fained sonne of the Earth for casting men to the ground. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. V, sig. 268a–268b
